en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Awrama, from Ali Bin Hassan, from Abdul Rahman Bin Kaseer who said,
about the Words of Allahazwj [18:44] Over here the Wilayah is for Allah, the Truth.
en.sarwar: 52. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Salama ibn al-Khattab from Ali ibn Hassa’n from ‘Abd al-Rahman ibn Kathir from abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.)
about the words of Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Gracious.
“God’s (means of purification and His) coloring. No coloring (purification) is better than that of God. and we (Muslims) worship Him.” [2:138]
The Imam (a.s.) said, “Allah has colored the believers with the Wilaya of Imam Ali (Leadership with Divine Authority) at the time He made to make the covenant.”
